name: b-villa-da-nang-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for B Villa Da Nang. Provides live tools to explore luxury villas, check availability, calculate rates, and query concierge details.

tools.name: list_villas
tools.description: List all available luxury private pool villas at B Villa Da Nang with capacity, location, bedrooms, bathrooms, and starting rates.

tools.name: get_villa_details
tools.description: Retrieve deep architectural details, bedroom configuration, pool specifications, address, and amenities for a specific villa.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check reservation availability for specified stay dates and villa selection.

tools.name: calculate_price
tools.description: Calculate the estimated total price in VND and USD for a stay based on villa, duration, and guests.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Get direct 24/7 concierge contact information, Hotline, WhatsApp link, Zalo link, and physical addresses.
